summary: Organization tenancy foundation: services/api/clipos_api/tenancy.py with frozen Pydantic v2 Organization (validated slug ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}$, active/suspended state) and Membership (owner/admin/member tenancy-only enum, active/removed state) contracts; runtime-checkable OrganizationStore and MembershipStore Protocols with thread-safe InMemoryOrganizationStore (slug-unique put_if_absent_by_slug) and InMemoryMembershipStore (unique (org_id, user_id) key, history kept by state so removal then re-add reactivates the same membership); and TenancyService with injected clock: slug-idempotent create_organization (replay returns existing org unchanged, org.created audited only on first), get_organization, set_org_state (org.suspended/org.reactivated, no-op replay without audit), idempotent add_member (member.added only on first activation; re-adding a removed member reactivates and audits), set_member_role (member.role_changed), idempotent remove_member (member.removed only on transition), last-active-owner invariant (remove/demote of the final active owner raises ValueError; with two owners demoting one succeeds), members_of_org/orgs_of_user filters, slug_available, and require_membership returning the active Membership or None (documented deny-by-default server-side tenant-scoping primitive per 07; returns None for removed memberships and suspended orgs; suspended orgs keep memberships readable). All privileged changes go through existing clipos_api.audit record()/read_events(); identity.py and audit.py untouched. services/api/tests/test_tenancy.py covers slug validation, create/add idempotency with exactly-one audit, lifecycle audit sequence, last-owner protection (remove raises, demote raises, 2-owner demote succeeds), require_membership tenant scoping (member vs non-member vs removed), listing filters, suspended-org rule, 8-thread same-slug -> 1 org and distinct-slug -> 8 orgs with injected clock and no sleeps. docs/development.md gained an 'Organization tenancy' paragraph (CLIP-008 RBAC out of scope; CLIP-010 SQL stores). No new dependencies, no SQL, no routes.
contracts_changed: services/api/clipos_api/tenancy.py: new Organization/Membership Pydantic contracts, OrganizationStore/MembershipStore Protocols, InMemory stores, TenancyService
